title: I'm new. Gemini 4 Argon or Opus 5.5?
author: Typical_Sky8316
selftext:
For the first time i'm thinking on buying an AI membership. I just don't know wich one is better for game dev, can someone clarify this? 

Also i want to use it for making webpages but mainly a game i have in mind. 

Ty!:D

comments.author: gravity-code
comments.body: Haven't tried Argon yet but Opus 5.5 is amazing imo

comments.author: TheAuthorBTLG_
comments.body: You should get a cheap subscription and try which one works best for you. Opus generally works better for me, because it works more in my direction.

comments.author: CashFirm573
comments.body: Opus but you will need highest subscription, or you run out fast Opus 5.5 high is decent, argon isn't anywhere as good, maybe bug testing.

replies.author: Recoil42
replies.body:
>Opus but you will need highest subscription

That just isn't true if you're a hobbyist. The $20 plan is enough to get started, and has quite a bit of usage. Move up only if you need it.

replies.author: cheyumaama
replies.body: If you're making an actual game from start to end, you will definitely need the highest subscription and more than one account too

replies.author: Recoil42
replies.body: That absolutely isn't true if you're a hobbyist.

comments.author: zenmatrix83
comments.body: claude and codex have been historically better gemini has been flaky, I haven' t tried 4 yet and there seems to be good results, but I get bit by bugs every time I try gemini

comments.author: Early_Flamingo5337
comments.body: well depends on what the game you have in mind needs would be better one or another

comments.author: terabitworld
comments.body: The good thing is that you don't have to choose, a Gemini subscription includes Opus 5.5 in Antigravity. Google is smart! You will need the highest Gemini subscription, though, because like others have mentioned you reach your Opus 5.5 weekly usage limit quick; however, you will get practically unlimited Gemini 4 usage, again making Google smart.

comments.author: AxiosXiphos
comments.body: Argon is okay, Opus is very powerful. If you want to code a whole game, go Opus.

comments.author: Odd_Throat1373
comments.body: I just tried Argon for my stock/option investing strategy, it's better than Opus 5.5's answer. Most of my current work is on opus 5.5 now and it's very powerful and easy to use. But for the investing part, I will change to Argon now, bcz I need the smartest model for that. After I tried Argon for longer period, maybe I move more work there, but it's not easy after you have done so much work in Opus 5.5 already.

comments.author: MacXou34
comments.body:
Havent tried Argon 4 yet. Would love to see what people manages to build with it.

Here's my latest creation with Opus 5.5, Voltane, a features packed RC car game (campaing, online, split screen...)

[Voltane](https://playvoltane.com)

Opus 5.5 truely is incredible, nothings stops it.

https://reddit.com/link/ph9yfpl/video/6qgvpuqb10wh1/player

comments.author: sirpalee
comments.body:
You are going to be the limiting factor, not the frontier model you chose.

Google ai subs also include a bunch of other google product benefits, so if you are using those it can hold more value.

comments.author: Melodic-Junket-9105
comments.body: Opus 5.5 for coding. Argon for everything else
